awards.case: Kiri Industries Ltd v Senda International Capital Ltd & Anor (CA - CAS 4/5)
awards.payer: Senda (out of net proceeds of en bloc sale)
awards.notes: Minority-oppression buy-out (s216 Companies Act). Kiri's DyStar shares fixed-valued at US$603.8m (Valuation of 3 Mar 2023); this CA judgment orders a discretionary enhancement at 5.33% p.a. on that US$603.8m, paid to Kiri in priority out of the en bloc sale proceeds. The US$603.8m is a buy-out valuation (not classic damages) and part of the long-running Kiri/Senda saga - treat with care in corpus totals.
